items.title: Brunies Brother Band Interview, 1957-10-19
items.q: Lawrence Waltz sings it every now and then.

ctx.x: Tiny Hill made a record of it, K-Stars. Where did everybody? There's a lot of left. Lawrence Waltz sings it every now and then. Perry Como had it on his fall show. And I got a man by the name of Dudley Mecham to put lyrics to. Where is he? Is he here? And George called me in Nightfall last and told me that there's a young boy come out with a small combo that made a terrific record of it. And it's a big, big thing in Chicago. So I've been wanting to just like.
Really? Did you get it? Okay.
